$description: Results of MIL-STD-2525 cross-version study from authoritative PDF documents.

H1.finding: B and C use identical 15-character SIDC field positions.

evidence.2525B: Appendix A, Section A.5.2.1: Position 1=Coding Scheme, 2=Affiliation, 3=Battle Dimension, 4=Status, 5-10=Function ID, 11-12=Symbol Modifier, 13-14=Country Code, 15=Order of Battle
evidence.2525C: Section 5.4.3 (same structure): Position 1=Code Scheme, 2=Standard Identity, 3=Battle Dimension, 4=Status, 5-10=Function ID, 11-12=Symbol Modifier, 13-14=Country Code, 15=Order of Battle
evidence.difference: C renames 'Affiliation' to 'Standard Identity' but the field position and encoding are identical

H2.finding: D and E use identical 20-character SIDC structure in two sets of 10.

evidence.2525D: Appendix A, Sections A.5.3 and A.5.4
evidence.2525E: Appendix A, Sections A.5.3 and A.5.4

H3.finding: Entity code 110200 is 'Rotary Wing' in Air symbol set. Entity=11 (Military), Type=02 (Rotary Wing), Subtype=00 (Unspecified).
H3.evidence: The 6-digit entity code is hierarchical: Entity(2) + Type(2) + Subtype(2). Entity 11=Military in Air. Type 01=Fixed Wing, 02=Rotary Wing, 03=UAV.

H4.finding: Sector modifier 1 transforms the base entity visually. s1=11 on Air entities adds Command Post designation.
H4.evidence: Pre-rendered SVGs with s1 included (e.g. s1=11) produce different symbols than without. mil-sym-ts renders modifiers in the SVG. Our manifest correctly maps lossy entries with s1/s2 to their modified SVGs.

H5.finding: Non-lossy entries map correctly (Function ID -> Entity code via NGA crosswalk). Lossy entries map to base entity + modifier composite, which is semantically correct but requires modifier rendering.
H5.evidence: 438 of 1,915 entries are lossy. Lossy entries use s1/s2 to create composite symbols. The NGA crosswalk is technically correct but the visual representation requires modifier rendering.

H6.finding: D (version 10/11) and E (version 13/15) share the same SIDC structure. E adds version codes 13-15.
H6.evidence: 2525E Table A-I shows version 10=2525D, 11=2525D(1), 13=2525E. Delta analysis: 2016 shared entities, 93 D-only, 150 E-only.

H7.finding: The 6-digit entity field IS a hierarchical 3-level code: Entity(2) + Entity Type(2) + Entity Subtype(2).
H7.evidence: 2525E Section A.5.4: 'The SIDC structure is organized using a logical three-tier hierarchy based on first, second and third order military functions; each tier is expressed using a pair of values.'

H8.finding: B/C Battle Dimension maps to D/E Symbol Set: A(Air)->01, P(Space)->05, G(Ground)->10, S(Sea Surface)->30, U(Sea Subsurface)->35, F(SOF)->not direct mapping, X(Other)->various.
H8.evidence: 2525B Table A-I: Battle Dimension codes P,A,G,S,U,F,X. 2525D/E symbol sets: 01=Air, 02=Air Missile, 05=Space, 06=Space Missile, 10=Land Unit, 11=Land Civilian, 15=Land Equipment, 20=Land Installation, 25=Control Measures, 30=Sea Surface, 35=Sea Subsurface, 36=Mine Warfare, 40=Activities.
